label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Pay-Per-Click (PPC)
body: Pay-Per-Click (PPC) is an advertising model where you pay a fee each time someone clicks on your ad.
caption:
Imagine you sell handmade jewelry. With PPC, your ad might show up when someone searches for 'unique silver earrings'. You only pay if they click your ad to visit your shop. It's a way to get your offerings in front of people actively looking for what you provide, helping potential customers discover you. Consider if PPC could be a fit for your specific offerings! ✨
